t: ShankhNaad user guide.
Meetings menu: Meetings.
The Meetings page is your calendar. Schedule meetings, answer invites, and join calls with your team and guests.
In this video, you will learn how to move around the calendar, schedule a meeting, answer an invite, and join it.
To open this page, click Meetings in the left menu.
Across the top are the buttons: Schedule, Edit, Delete, Export, Print, Join, and Meet now.
Use the arrows and Today to move through time.
Pick a view: Day, Week, Month, Agenda or List.
Agenda shows each meeting with its agenda and who is coming.
On the right, This week shows live, upcoming and ended meetings, and your calls.
Click a meeting to see its time, agenda, and who has accepted.
Answer with Accept, Maybe or Decline, or press Join to go in.
To set one up, press Schedule.
Type a title, choose the date, start time and duration.
Pick the people to invite, or a whole team. Guests from outside get a link by email.
Availability shows who is free. Find a time suggests a slot that suits everyone, skipping holidays and out of office.
Choose whether it repeats, then press Schedule. Everyone gets it in their calendar, chat and email.
Meet now starts a meeting straight away.
The organiser can cancel a meeting with a reason. It stays on everyone's calendar, marked Cancelled.
That completes the Meetings page.
Next in the Meetings menu: In a call or meeting.
